1. llg_001 'Assign ambulance to emergency call within 11-minute window' - This LLG is supported by the system logic enforcing time-based constraints via the Computer Aided Despatch (CAD) system, ensuring an available ambulance reaches the scene within 11 minutes of call receipt.
2. llg_002 'Record departure and destination information via standard communication protocol' - This LLG is supported by the standardized radio communication procedures used by ambulance staff to record accurate data entry into the CAD system for resource allocation.
3. llg_003 'Track ambulance location in real-time using standard routes' - This LLG is supported by the real-time monitoring of ambulance locations following predefined standard routes, enabling optimal routing and response time monitoring via the CAD system.

No unsupported or misleading LLGs were identified. The scope of each LLG is appropriate, and there is no redundancy in their descriptions.
